effects.text: You may stabilize to 5 immediately.
If you have 7 or fewer traits in your trait pile, you may play 1 effectless now.

Draw 3.

Discard them OR all other cards in your hand.

Draw 2 from the top of the discard pile.

(If empty, draw from the trait deck.)

On your turn:
If you play an attachment ({attachment}), you may play another trait.

Discard 2 from hand, or 1 at random.

(If this effect empties your hand, draw 3.)
Instead of taking your turn, you may draw and play 1 from the top 4 of the discard pile.

Draw 1.

If you play Slumbering this age, you may draw 4 and play another trait.
Discard all face value 3 or higher from hand, then stabilize.
-7 if your trait count is higher than 20.
Discard 3 from hand and stabilize. Cannot discard Mythlings ({mythling}).
If you hold any Mythlings ({mythling}), add their face value to your final score.
Discard 1 from hand for each Techling ({techling}) in your trait pile. Then draw 1 for each card you discard.
Discard 2 attachments in your trait pile.
If you have any dominants in your trait pile, discard all but 1 from hand.

+3 if you have a dominant Mythling ({mythling}), Dinoling ({dinoling}), or Techling ({techling}) in your trait pile.

+6 if you have 2.
